O noapte.

Fără angajamente.

Fără nume.

O experiență memorabilă.

Încă mă simt plină de energie după aventura de aseară când, intrând să-mi întâlnesc noul client, observ zâmbetul lui provocator care m-a cucerit cu doar câteva ore în urmă.

Callahan Sharpe este moștenitorul miliardar care sfidează regulile, poartă mereu costume impecabile și emană o combinație amețitoare de bogăție, nonconformism și senzualitate. Este decis să finalizeze un ultim proiect pentru a onora memoria tatălui său decedat, înainte de a se retrage din afacerea de familie. Din păcate și din fericire pentru mine, am fost delegată să călătoresc în Insulele Virgine pentru a-l ajuta să-și îndeplinească visul. Callahan nu are nicio problemă să încalce politica companiei care interzice relațiile intime între partenerii de afaceri, însă eu nu-mi pot permite acest lucru. Sunt prea multe în joc.
Ce ar putea să meargă prost atunci când ești obligată să lucrezi și să trăiești alături de un bărbat căruia nu-i poți rezista?

About the author

K. Bromberg

114 books19.6k followers
New York Times Bestselling author K. Bromberg writes contemporary romance novels that make you work to get your happily ever after. She likes to write strong heroines and damaged heroes, who we love to hate but can’t help but love.

Since publishing her first book on a whim in 2013, Kristy has sold over two million copies of her books across twenty different countries and has landed on the New York Times, USA Today, and Wall Street Journal Bestsellers lists over thirty times.

A mom of three, Kristy finds the only thing harder than finishing the book she’s writing is navigating parenthood during the teenage years (send more wine!). She loves dogs, sports, a good book, and is an expert procrastinator. She lives in Southern California with her family.

4 STARS
Cute, but rest assured, I don’t beg, and I’m far from interested.” Who the hell is this girl right now?
“Is that a challenge?” he asks, those eyes of his freezing me in my place as a ghost of a smirk plays on his lips.
“It’s a fact.”
“Everyone begs. When it’s good enough . . . you beg.”

This series introduces not one, not two, but three to die for heroes. And they're brothers...and identical twins. Catch your attention? I bet I did. But I get ahead of myself, so let's talk about this book.

Sutton is a woman who recently lost herself to a toxic relationship with a selfish, domineering man. She's given up everything, until enough is enough. She finally puts herself first by accepting the promotion of her dreams, and then dumps the baggage of her ex. Out with her friends to celebrate, the last thing she wants is another complication of a man. But when a sinfully sexy stranger says all the right things offers her a sizzling night of passion the likes of which she hasn't felt in years, she gives in.
Your ex may have allowed you to be silent, but that’s because he was a selfish prick. I want to hear you say what you want. I want to know I’m making you feel how you want to feel. I want the neighbors on either side of these walls to call the front desk because you’re screaming so loud one minute and begging me for more the next. Is that understood?”

So imagine her surprise when she walks into work to meet her new clients from her promotion, and sees triple. As in the mysterious stranger from her one night stand and his two carbon copies, and she has no idea who her stranger is. Then to complicate matters even more, we add in some forced proximity when she has to travel to the virgin islands with one of them to turn around their failing investment of a luxury resort...still having no idea if this man is the one she spent the night with, or if it's one of his brothers.

This is where things get really interesting. There's a ton of character development that happens in the next part of the book. I really loved seeing Sutton's backbone. Even when Callahan throws every seduction tactic her way, she doesn't give in and makes him work for it. The chemistry between them crackles with all of the passion, but it's a slow burn to beat all slow burns.

Callahan's layers get peeled back with each new revelation and flashback to his history with his father. Seen as the irresponsible one who just cars about chasing women by his father, the tension between him and his brothers is intense. There's so much resentment, judgement, and pain hidden under all of the love they clearly have for each other. I loved watching his slow decent from lust to realizing it's so much more to what he feels for Sutton. It was an interesting take to see them go from o to 60 back to 0 in the first third of the book, but all of it was deliciously entertaining.

Last Resort is a great start to what shows to be a promising and sizzling new series from K Bromberg and I'm so here for it!

K. Bromberg comes back with a new series and she is starting with a bang! Not that I am surprised because this woman’s writing is my own brand of heroin. Her stories are just THAT addicting. So, she starts this series introducing three gorgeous twin brothers (yes, you read that correctly, THREE identical twins) that will drive us crazy with lust. I already know the first one has stolen my heart and the heroine’s too. Smart, sexy and full of emotions, get ready for Last Resort and the addicting start to Kristy’s brand-new series!

As I said, Last Resort is the first installment in Bromberg’s new series called S.I.N. And this one is focused on the younger Sharpe twin, Callahan Sharpe. Enter Sutton Pierce. Sutton is going through some changes and she feels ready for them after having the best sex of her life with a complete stranger. But what happens when your new job (that can help you win the promotion you’ve been waiting for) is in danger because your new boss happens to be the stranger you met the night before? Will Sutton and Callahan be able to resist this forbidden connection that seems impossible to ignore or will other feelings start getting in the way?

Staring at her, I feel like a man drowning for water, and she is the water.

Well. I am already in love with this series and the Sharpe brothers. What a way to start! I devoured Last Resort in just a few hours because Sutton and Callahan’s chemistry is simply addicting. Kristy told us this series would be even steamier than others and she is not wrong. These two BURN the pages when they are together in the same room. Holy moly, what an amazing couple! I absolutely adored Sutton and Callahan, they just click in a very especial way and it’s impossible to miss their connection from start to finish. I loved seeing them being vulnerable and peeling many of the layers that made their relationship even more beautiful to read. That forbidden chemistry turns into so much more and I just loved seeing this couple get their happy ending.

I just want him. More of him. All of him. Endless amounts of him.

Therefore, I am rating Last Resort with 5 STARS because it’s the perfect start to this brand-new series and make old and new readers fall in love with K. Bromberg’s incredible writing and characters. I love how she keeps giving us steam but without forgetting the importance of being vulnerable and showing emotions. Sutton and Callahan are so good together and I am sure many will love their beautiful love story. Guys, don’t miss this and start the S.I.N series as soon as you can!

Loved it

"Oh fu..." (and a little gasp) was my reaction to the first chapter, and I immediately knew that I was going to be in for a devourable read, the kind where you sit back and enjoy the show. And this is definitely that. I binged this in one sitting with zero regrets - the story is tense, chemistry-filled, and like a sexy cat and mouse chase. It's a SIZZLE to slow burn, in that this couple starts with a HOT one night stand before discovering that they'll be working together. I loved that the emotional connection built slow and steady throughout the story, with our playboy hero off-balance the entire time. He's never had to work hard for a girl, but he finds himself drawn to the heroine in a way that's undeniable. It reads quickly, easily held my attention the whole way through, and has me very very excited for future interconnected standalones in the series.

The story follows Sutton, a woman who realizes that she's been putting her own needs after her boyfriend's. When she finally does one thing for herself - accept a promotion - it's the end of that relationship. On the rebound, Sutton meets a sexy stranger at a bar and soon finds herself going up to his room. They both know they'll have one night only, no names are exchanged, and the night makes Sutton feel empowered... until she walks into a meeting the next day and sees the man she just spent the night with. Well... three of him. Turns out, that sexy stranger is a triplet who runs a business with his brothers, and Sutton has just been tasked with consulting on a project. As the chemistry continues to spark between Sutton and her one night stand, she realizes that the dynamic needs to change. There's no way she'll be respected professionally if she knowingly sleeps with the boss, but denying the chemistry is impossible.

Bromberg is an easy one-click author for me, so I was excited to dig into this new series and see what it's all about. The vibe reminded me of the Wicked Ways duet (my favorite from her), with a ZAP of connection, tons of banter, a slow build in intimacy, and heated moments in nearly every interaction. Each book will follow one of the triplets, and I can't wait to get to know the other two better. This made quite the first impression, wasting zero time getting right into the action. I loved the intensity of that first steamy scene, and it certainly cemented the chemistry between these two. Our hero doesn't know how to handle what he's feeling, and watching him struggle was so much fun. He undergoes a great transformation throughout the book, making their happily ever after fulfilling. The subtle shifts in their relationship kept this feeling tense and sexy for most of the story - entirely bingeable and compelling.

Audio note: The audio was excellent! Stella Hunter and Aaron Shedlock both do a great job, with performances that showcase the chemistry and emotion. Their voices are both easy to listen to, the overall quality is solid, and the dual narration enhanced the reading experience. The runtime is under 8 hours, so it's easy to finish in one day (or one sitting, if you're like me, lol). Not necessarily a book that I would recommend for a workday listen - the heat starts quickly, and there are sexually charged interactions throughout. But this was a really good audio experience, and I wholeheartedly recommend it.

Sutton is a consultant, and her firm is going to be working for the Sharpe brothers. When she meets them, she is shocked to find that they are identical triplets, and she was with one of them the night before. But which one? Is it Fordham, Ledger, or Callahan? They never traded names, it was only supposed to be one night. They were never going to see each other again. As fate would have it, her best laid plans are not turning out the way she planned. Can Sutton get past this and be the professional she's always been, keeping him at arm's length, or will he break down her walls and make them both realize they are destined to be together.

This is classic Bromberg! It's a great story. It has the sexiness we've come to expect, there is banter between Collins and Johnny (love these nicknames), it's got angst between the brothers, and the love of a father who loved his wife so much, he wanted to see his promise to her come true. This story brings the brothers closure and a closeness and bond that can't be severed. It made me laugh and cry several times.

Last Resort is the first of three books that can all be read as standalones.

Sutton’s feeling high on life… That is until she walks in to her new job only to find out that not only is her one-night stand her new boss, but he’s also a triplet and she can’t tell which one he is because they’re all identical! 🙃

This was a fun, sexy, and flirty read that also packed some emotion when it came to “Johnnie” and his family.

Would recommend this book to fans of workplace romances, forced proximity, and don’t hate the playa/recovering playboy tropes. Also, the bulk of the story takes place at a tropical resort!

This was my second read by this author and I will definitely be reading the rest of this series. I’m here for ALL the things about these brothers!!

Last Resort by K. Bromberg is the first book of the S.I.N. Series and this is Sutton and Callahan‘s story.

Sutton was miserable in her relationship and finally decides to end it and she has a one night stand. Now she can actually focus more on herself and her job brings her the opportunity to work in a hotel on the Virgin Islands and this change of scenery is everything she needs. At the same time she isn’t there alone and her clients are no other than the Sharpe brothers and one of them keeps her company on the island. Sutton is an amazing character and I love her.

Callahan is one of the Sharpe brothers and the brothers are a bit estranged and I liked to learn more about their family and already can’t wait for the other books in this series. Callahan is such a fine man and totally a new bookboyfriend.

Sutton and Callahan are such a power couple and they work together so well. I especially liked that Sutton doesn’t give in easily and Callahan really has to show her why they should be together. The sparks between them are fire and the banter was everything and created an even better tension between them. The steamy scenes are stunning and at the same time there are sweet moments like at the end.

Overall, Last Resort is everything and more and one of my new absolute favorites. It just has everything from amazing characters, a paradise setting and all the chemistry. 5 stars.

It’s always a good sign when you finish a book with tears of happiness in your eyes, right? That’s what happened with the first in the S.I.N. Series from K. Bromberg. Spoiler alert: there is always a HEA when the characters are this good.

Meet Sutton. People pleaser to a fault allowing people to walk all over her. When her BFF has a come-to-Jesus talk with her and makes her promise to do just one thing for herself she rises to the task… but she has no idea what she’s gotten herself into when she walks into that conference room. Will she prove to herself that she deserves everything she has always dreamed of or will she settle?

Enter Callahan. Consummate bachelor, king of one night stands, favorite son, resented brother. He never expected to see her again yet there she was accepting a job where he would be forced to work alongside her when all he wants is to be inside her again. Can he prove himself to his brothers and fulfill his dad’s final wish or will he be selfish and ensure this is his last resort?

I had so many tummy flips reading the teasing banter between these two, the memories of that night, the intensity of how hard it was to keep things professional… then the heart wrenching scenes of how things between the brothers got to be so bad and the secrets kept to get to the final endgame. This was so well written with just enough physical intimacy in all the right places. The vulnerability and emotional connection Sutton & Callahan shared pulled at the heartstrings and I can’t wait for the next installment.

Last Resort is hands down one of K. Bromberg's best books! The story was refreshing and nothing like anything I've ever read and I loved every single page!

5 S.I.N.fully hot stars for this deliciously spicy Last Resort

What a great start to this series of stand-alones for three extremely sexy brothers 😍 It was the perfect mix of steam, witty banter, intriguing characters, some healthy amount of drama, dynamic plot and altogether - a great romance. Add to that mix the full gamut of emotions - laughter, passion, insecurities, anger, self-doubt, fear, sadness, but above all sweet and beautiful love. And you got yourself another great story to indulge in.

It seemed like a very well used trope - the rich owner of a multimillion dollars corporation and a woman who works for him but it was so well thought and written that I swallowed it in no time.

Both Sutton and Callahan were typical Bromberg characters. A bit insecure heroine who is good at her job and needs a little push to see her worth. And a very attractive, cocky hero who seems very confident and self assured on the outside but who has his vulnerable side and self doubts inside. They were an explosive couple but somehow fit perfectly. I really enjoyed their dynamics, laughed out loud with their witty conversations while they were trying to one up each other, but mostly I was enjoying the whole slow process of them falling for each other. Without even realizing it, through this whole process they managed to show the other their strong sides and boost their confidence. I loved to see their growth through the story and what a perfect match they were at the end.

This was a quick read that grabbed my attention from the start and wouldn't let me leave it till I reached the end. And now I'm so curious and eager to see what the other two brothers would be up to and who is going to be their match. A very promising beginning to this S.I.N.fully sexy series 🥰
